purpose: Functional reproducibility check for B5 (TALO) per Section 6, Design-Entscheidung E4: live end-to-end run over all 60 tasks, compared against the Phase 2 cache at temperature=0.0.

notes.sql_generation: 7/15 deviations at the text level; 3/7 changed the execution-accuracy score (all cached=0 -> live=1). One case (sql_005) was a literal SQL syntax typo in the cached generation ('THTHEN') that self-corrected in the live regeneration; the other two (sql_009, sql_010) reflect different join/filter choices, not reproducibility artifacts of the extractor.
notes.kpi_interpretation: 14/15 deviations -- wording/phrasing differences only (same figures, direction, and conclusion in every case checked); not re-judged live to avoid additional API cost, since B5's reported score always uses the Phase-2-cache judge score regardless.
notes.report_generation: 15/15 deviations -- wording/phrasing differences only, same pattern as KPI.
notes.conclusion: temperature=0.0 does not guarantee byte-identical output from the Gemini, Claude, and GPT APIs used here; only anomaly_detection (JSON-only output) was fully reproducible. This does not affect the Chapter 6 reported scores, which always use the Phase-2 cache for B5, but should be noted as a limitation of 'temperature=0.0 implies determinism' in Section 7.4.
